methodology: The decomposition process involves breaking down the research topic and the generated specification into atomic units. The criteria for each unit are: independence, technical specificity, unambiguity, and implementability as a single requirement. The approach involves identifying key functionalities, behaviors, and constraints. For the research topic, I will extract the core requirements directly from the prompt. For the generated specification, I will analyze the provided JSON structures and extract the essential design elements described in each section, including the header, combinational logic function, and timing logic summary. I will focus on the functional behavior, input/output relationships, and timing dependencies.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Sample input 'd' on rising edge of clk
When r is high, q is 0
When r is low, flip-flop captures d on clock edge
spec_atomic_units: Module has clk, d, r, and q
Reset signal r forces q to 0 on clock edge
q is either d (when not reset) or 0 (when reset)
Reset signal r has highest priority
On rising edge of clk: If r is high, q becomes 0
On rising edge of clk: If r is low, q becomes equal to d
q depends on rising edge of clk, d, and r
r has to be stable before rising edge of clk
Setup and hold times of flip-flop must be met for d and r
q is updated on the positive edge of clk
If r is high, q is set to 0
Otherwise, q is assigned the value of d
